name: Vertebrate Genomes Project assemblies
blurb: Reference-quality vertebrate genome assemblies produced by the Vertebrate Genomes Project and affiliated efforts, as listed by the UCSC VGP assembly hub. Each assembly is identified here by a sequence collection digest, with any refgenie assets built for it.
note: An independent refgenie view of publicly available assemblies. Not run by the Vertebrate Genomes Project.
